name: ProgressBar
description: A horizontal fill over a faint track, with optional value text beside it in tabular numerals.
usage: Use for a bounded amount, not for loading: no indeterminate state
Grows to fill its row; the value text keeps its width
xs is a 4px bar; sm 6px, md 8px, lg 12px
examples: <ProgressBar value={372} max={500} size="xs" tone="caution" label="PM context" valueLabel="372k of 500k" />
design: Track border-default; fill and value text in the tone colour
Width transitions over --duration-travel, instant under reduced motion
accessibility: The track is role=meter with aria-valuemin/max/now and aria-valuetext
A string valueLabel becomes the valuetext; the visible copy is aria-hidden

props.name: tone
props.description: default draws in text-muted; caution and danger in the caution-fg and error-fg action tokens

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: How a screen reader reads the value, e.g. "372k of 500k"; defaults to the percentage

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Shown beside the bar, e.g. "372k of 500k"
